Alexander Sorloth.note: Sorloth has often started wide of Haaland, which makes Norway more physical without losing a striker's instincts. He pins defenders so the main service lane stays open.
Alexander Sorloth.noteZh: 索尔洛特常常在哈兰德身边偏边路首发，让挪威更有身体对抗，同时不失前锋本能。他牵制防守者，让主要传球线路保持打开。

Andreas Schjelderup.note: Schjelderup became Norway's late-game key against Brazil, assisting both Haaland goals. He is the left-sided creator who can make one tired defensive step fatal.
Andreas Schjelderup.noteZh: 谢尔德鲁普在对巴西时成为挪威后段关键，两次助攻哈兰德。他是左侧创造者，能让防守者一次疲劳脚步付出代价。

Antonio Nusa.note: Nusa is Norway's young winger who stretches the first defender before Haaland attacks the box. He keeps the attack from becoming only Odegaard to Haaland.
Antonio Nusa.noteZh: 努萨是挪威年轻边锋，会先拉扯第一名防守者，再让哈兰德冲击禁区。他让进攻不只是厄德高传给哈兰德。

David Moller Wolfe.note: Wolfe assisted Haaland in the opener and has kept giving Norway left-side width. He is a release valve when the midfield cannot turn cleanly.
David Moller Wolfe.noteZh: 沃尔夫在首战助攻哈兰德，也持续给挪威左路宽度。当中场无法干净转身时，他是出球阀门。

Egil Selvik.note: Selvik is Norway's goalkeeper depth and already started the France match. He gives direct distribution when Norway need the first pass to travel quickly.
Egil Selvik.noteZh: 塞尔维克是挪威的门将深度，也已经在对法国时首发。当挪威需要第一脚传球快速推进时，他提供直接出球。

Erling Haaland.note: Haaland scored seven goals in Norway's run to the quarter-finals. Even with few touches, his runs behind the defence and finishing can turn one clear chance into a goal.
Erling Haaland.noteZh: 哈兰德在挪威闯入八强的旅程中攻入七球。即使触球不多，他的反越位跑动和终结能力也能把一次清晰机会变成进球。

Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.note: Bjorkan is Norway's left-back runner for rotated matches. He gives overlap energy, but his bigger job is recovering before the counter reaches the centre-backs.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.noteZh: 比约尔坎是挪威轮换比赛中的左后卫跑动点。他提供套边活力，但更大的任务是在反击到达中卫前回追。

Fredrik Aursnes.note: Aursnes is Norway's plug-in problem solver. He has appeared in midfield and wider roles, giving Odegaard and Haaland the platform to stay aggressive.
Fredrik Aursnes.noteZh: 奥尔斯内斯是挪威哪里需要补哪里的解题人。他踢过中场也踢过更宽的位置，为厄德高和哈兰德保持进攻性提供平台。

Henrik Falchener.note: Falchener is young centre-back size for Norway. He is there when the match needs height, simple clearances, and a defender who does not overplay.
Henrik Falchener.noteZh: 法尔赫纳是挪威年轻的高大型中卫。当比赛需要身高、简单解围和不多处理球的防守者时，他有价值。

Jens Petter Hauge.note: Hauge is a bench route to a left-sided dribble. Norway would use him if the first plan has become too direct and the attack needs another touch before the shot.
Jens Petter Hauge.noteZh: 豪格是挪威替补席上左侧带球路线。如果第一计划变得过于直接，而进攻需要射门前多一脚处理，他就有意义。

Jorgen Strand Larsen.note: Strand Larsen is the alternate centre-forward when Norway rotate away from Haaland. He keeps centre-backs occupied and lets the wide runners play off a target.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.noteZh: 斯特兰德·拉尔森是挪威轮换哈兰德时的替代中锋。他牵制中卫，让边路跑动者能围绕支点踢球。

Julian Ryerson.note: Ryerson is Norway's intense right-back, and his minutes have been worth watching after the Senegal injury note. When fit, he gives the team duels and straight-line running.
Julian Ryerson.noteZh: 雷尔森是挪威高强度右后卫，塞内加尔一战的伤情提示后，他的出场时间值得关注。健康时，他提供对抗和直线跑动。

Kristian Thorstvedt.note: Thorstvedt gives Norway a taller midfielder who can arrive after Haaland has occupied the centre-backs. He turns second waves into real shots.
Kristian Thorstvedt.noteZh: 托斯特维特给挪威提供更高大的中场，在哈兰德牵制中卫后插上。他能把第二波进攻变成真正射门。

Kristoffer Ajer.note: Ajer gives Norway the defender who can carry the ball out instead of only clearing it. That matters when England press and Norway need the first escape.
Kristoffer Ajer.noteZh: 阿耶尔让挪威拥有能带球出来而不只是解围的后卫。对英格兰压迫时，这条第一出路很重要。

Leo Ostigard.note: Ostigard brings Norway's edge at centre-back and already scored from Odegaard service. He makes set pieces feel like part of the attack, not a bonus.
Leo Ostigard.noteZh: 厄斯蒂高给挪威中卫位置带来锋芒，也已经接厄德高传球破门。他让定位球像进攻的一部分，而不是额外奖励。

Marcus Holmgren Pedersen.note: Pedersen scored the opener against Senegal and later covered right-back in the knockout run. His value is speed that can become either pressure or recovery.
Marcus Holmgren Pedersen.noteZh: 霍尔姆格伦·佩德森对塞内加尔首开纪录，之后也在淘汰赛中补上右后卫。他的价值是速度，既能变成压力，也能变成回追。

Martin Odegaard.note: Odegaard is the timing of Norway's attack. His passes do not have to be spectacular if they arrive early enough for Haaland or Nusa to meet a defense still turning.
Martin Odegaard.noteZh: 厄德高是挪威进攻的时机。他的传球不必总是华丽，只要足够早，让哈兰德或努萨面对还在转身的防线。

Morten Thorsby.note: Thorsby is Norway's contact midfielder. If the match against England turns scrappy, he is built for second balls and slowing the next runner.
Morten Thorsby.noteZh: 托尔斯比是挪威的对抗型中场。如果对英格兰变成混战，他适合争第二落点并拖慢下一名跑动者。

Orjan Nyland.summary: Ørjan Nyland is a Norway goalkeeper from Sevilla FC who gives the national team veteran shot stopping, box command, and tournament experience.
Orjan Nyland.note: Nyland is the veteran goalkeeper behind Norway's knockout push. His calm matters because this team can invite pressure while waiting for Haaland's moment.
Orjan Nyland.noteZh: 尼兰是挪威淘汰赛推进背后的老将门将。他的冷静很重要，因为这支球队会在等待哈兰德时刻时承受压力。

Oscar Bobb.note: Bobb is Norway's silkier wide creator. He did not start every big match, but he is the player who can receive in traffic and make the attack less predictable.
Oscar Bobb.noteZh: 鲍勃是挪威更细腻的边路创造者。他并非每场大赛都首发，但能在人群中接球，让进攻不那么容易预测。

Patrick Berg.note: Berg has quietly supplied big moments, including Haaland against Senegal and the winner against Côte d'Ivoire. He gives Norway early passes from deeper zones.
Patrick Berg.noteZh: 贝格安静地提供了关键时刻，包括对塞内加尔助攻哈兰德、对科特迪瓦助攻制胜球。他从更深位置送出早传。

Sander Berge.note: Berge gives Norway the stride through midfield. When opponents crowd Odegaard, Berge can carry the ball far enough to change the angle.
Sander Berge.noteZh: 贝格给挪威提供中场大步推进。当对手围住厄德高时，他能带球推进到足够远，改变进攻角度。

Sander Tangvik.note: Tangvik is Norway's younger goalkeeper depth. His tournament role is cover behind Nyland and Selvik rather than a likely quarter-final story.
Sander Tangvik.noteZh: 唐维克是挪威更年轻的门将深度。他在这届赛事中的角色是尼兰和塞尔维克身后的保障，而不是八强战主线。

Sondre Langas.note: Langas is centre-back cover for the aerial spells. Norway would use him when the box needs one more defender who can attack the first ball.
Sondre Langas.noteZh: 朗格斯是挪威应对空中阶段的中卫深度。当禁区需要多一名能争第一点的防守者时，他有价值。

Thelo Aasgaard.note: Aasgaard scored Norway's consolation against France and stays interesting as a late midfield runner. He can make the second wave more than just support.
Thelo Aasgaard.noteZh: 奥斯高在对法国时打进挪威的安慰球，也仍是有趣的后插上中场。他能让第二波进攻不只是支援。

Torbjorn Heggem.note: Heggem has been part of Norway's main defensive shape. He is the steady left-sided cover who keeps the back line from chasing every wide run.
Torbjorn Heggem.noteZh: 赫格姆是挪威主要防守结构的一部分。他是稳定的左侧保护，避免整条后防线都去追每一次边路跑动。
